note: 要生的圖都列在這裡,tools/gen.py 照這份產提示詞(有 Codex CLI 就自動生),tools/process.py 照這份切圖。scene = 一張直式場景 1024×1536;sheet = 洋紅底素材表 1536×1024,items 由左上起逐列排。h = 目標高度(格,一格 6px;主角約 58 格高),group 相同的幾格維持同一比例(同一角色不同動作一樣大)。scene 加 "key": true = 天空畫成洋紅、處理時變透明(後面就能放星空或會動的東西)。sheet 加 "grid": true = 照格子切(角色靠太近會黏在一起時)。note = 整張共用的說明(角色長相);ref = 長相參考圖路徑(Codex 用 -i 附上)。

jobs.prompt: Interior of a retro neon video game arcade at night, side view like a side-scrolling game: a long row of colorful upright arcade cabinets with glowing screens along the back wall, neon tube lights and glowing stars on the dark wall above, a claw machine on the far left edge, a prize counter on the far right edge, patterned arcade carpet. The lower part (from about 60% to 100% of the height) must be a plain, mostly empty carpet floor so game sprites can stand on it later; keep the bottom 20% simple and slightly darker.

jobs.note: Every sprite is the same chibi kid adventurer (about 2 heads tall) drawn as a cute 16-bit SNES JRPG pixel sprite: a teal baseball cap worn slightly tilted; short dark brown hair; big round black eyes with one white highlight; small smile; an orange scarf; a cream short-sleeve shirt; a small brown backpack; navy shorts; red sneakers. The face, clothes and colors never change between poses; only the pose and the eyes change. The walking frames must show clearly different leg positions.
